meta.title: Surrogate bids are visibly distinguished from vendor-placed bids in the QCS
gaps: Assert that the QCS header shows the "Surrogate Bid" marker in blue specifically under the surrogate vendor's name and is absent under the self-bidding vendor's name.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Assert that the QCS header shows the "Surrogate Bid" marker in blue specifically under the surrogate vendor's name and is absent under the self-bidding vendor's name.

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Configure the event as an RFQ-only project.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add one product for the bids.
Invite two vendors so one can bid directly and the other can receive a surrogate bid.
Publish the RFQ so bids can be submitted.
Confirm the RFQ reached its published event page.
Submit a vendor-placed bid from the first invited vendor.
Confirm the direct vendor bid was accepted.
Enter a bid on behalf of the other invited vendor from the buyer console.
Confirm the surrogate bid was accepted.
Verify the buyer records one direct response and one response explicitly tagged as a surrogate bid.
Open the RFQ Master QCS, the subject screen for the requested header comparison.
Confirm the QCS visibly contains the surrogate-bid marker.
